description.content: Use this API call to create an order using a Klarna Customer Token. Make sure you use the correct token ID when placing an order, to ensure that the right consumer gets billed. Read more on **[Create a new order using the customer token](https://docs.klarna.com/klarna-payments/integrate-with-klarna-payments/step-3-create-an-order/set-up-a-recurring-payment-order/#create-an-order-with-a-customer-token)**.
